name: insurance
description: SaaS de gestão e cotação para corretoras de seguros

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api -w apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web,pkg -c blue,green,gray "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w packages/shared"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:packages && npm run seed -w packages/database
scripts.postinstall: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages
